data.title: Why Rivers Flood
data.passage: Heavy rains fall on the high mountains for many days. Rivers fill up with rushing water because the ground gets too wet to hold any more. The banks overflow onto nearby fields. People must move to higher ground so they stay safe. Mud covers the roads as a result of the rising water.
